media:content.media:description: WASHINGTON DC - APRIL 26: Teka Adams shows the scar where her abductor cut open her abdomen to take her baby. SUMMARY: Teka Adams, a victim who was abducted while 9 months pregnant and held hostage for 4 days. Her attacker sliced open her abdomen in an attempt to take her baby. Teka escaped despite severe injuries, and the baby, Miracle, was delivered safely. She is now trying to get her life and family back on track after the ordeal. Teka and family at their first apartment in Washington DC on April 26, 2010 (Photo by Carol Guzy/The Washington Post via Getty Images )
media:content.media:credit: The Washington Post via Getty Images
